nodes.summary: For every natural number $s$, the minimum size $k^*(s)$ of a restricted additive basis of $\{0, 1, \dots, s\}$, that is, of a finite set $A$ of natural numbers with $2a \le s$ for every $a \in A$ such that every natural number $x \le s$ equals $a + b$ for some $a, b \in A$, is undefined if and only if $s$ is odd.
nodes.title: The minimum restricted additive basis size is undefined exactly in the odd case

nodes.summary: For every natural number $s$, the minimum size $k^*(s)$ of a restricted additive basis of $\{0, 1, \dots, s\}$, that is, of a finite set $A$ of natural numbers with $2a \le s$ for every $a \in A$ such that every natural number $x \le s$ equals $a + b$ for some $a, b \in A$, is defined if and only if $s$ is even.
nodes.title: The minimum restricted additive basis size is defined exactly in the even case

nodes.summary: Let $s$ be a natural number. A restricted additive basis of $\{0, 1, \dots, s\}$ is a finite set $A$ of natural numbers with $2a \le s$ for every $a \in A$ such that every natural number $x \le s$ can be written as $x = a + b$ with $a, b \in A$, where $a = b$ is allowed. The minimum restricted additive basis size $k^*(s)$ is the smallest cardinality of a restricted additive basis of $\{0, 1, \dots, s\}$; it is…
nodes.title: Minimum size of a restricted additive basis

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
